sourceIssues.locator: §3, published p.493 (PDF p.7), Annals of Mathematics 192 (2020), 487–497; arXiv 1907.13617v1/v2 p.5; HAL hal-02375397v1 PDF p.7 (manuscript p.6).
sourceIssues.printed: We set L = 𝓛 ⊗_Q R as the underlying R-vector space
sourceIssues.correction: L = 𝓛 ⊗_Z R, the real span of 𝓛 in V_R (equivalently (𝓛 ⊗_Z Q) ⊗_Q R).
sourceIssues.reason: The preceding definition makes 𝓛 the kernel of integral polynomial evaluation in the finite free Z-module V_Z. Its rank ℓ = C(d+r,d) − n is positive: the standing assumptions give ℓ ≥ nr ≥ 1. A basis vector of a nonzero finite free Z-module is not divisible by 2, so this Z-module admits no compatible Q-module structure. Thus the displayed tensor product needs Z as its base ring. Extending the integral evaluation matrix to R identifies 𝓛 ⊗_Z R with its real kernel and real span in V_R. This supplies the space used for orthogonality and successive minima.

review.reason: Independently checked the published p.493 page image, arXiv v1/v2 p.5, v2 TeX and HAL manuscript PDF p.7. The positive-rank free abelian group is not a Q-module; tensoring over Z gives exactly the required real span. Retain misprint / affects nothing and the original correction. Shortened the quotation and made the version locators and correction search explicit. Separately corrected the companion report’s transcription of the volume inequality: the paper prints ≥, not >; that is not an additional source error.
